_about: brake2: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/brake2.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

ax.plant_p.dig._orig: the first bite of the brake: the weight dropping, the near arm snapping out ahead of him, a heel reaching for the air

ax.plant_p.hold._orig: planted on the air: hips dropped, one leg thrown out ahead toward where he is going with the foot flat, the other knee bent behind it, the near arm pressed out ahead and the far arm swung back for the balance, the chest turned to the foe

ax.plant_p.exit._orig: out of the plant: the legs drawing under him, the arms coming in

ax.plant_r.dig._orig: the first bite of the brake: the weight dropping, the near fist snapping out ahead of him, a heel reaching for the air

ax.plant_r.hold._orig: planted on the air like a wall: hips dropped, one leg driven out ahead toward where he is going, the other knee bent behind it, the near fist braced out ahead and the far fist swung back, the chest turned to the foe

ax.plant_r.exit._orig: out of the plant: the legs drawing under him, the fists coming in

ax.regain_p.tuck._orig: the knees drawn up and the hands brought in, the weight gathered to turn

ax.regain_p.open._orig: the arms swept out and down, the legs dropped under him: he has the air back

ax.regain_r.tuck._orig: the knees drawn up and the fists brought in, the weight gathered to turn

ax.regain_r.open._orig: the fists thrown out and down, the legs dropped under him: he has the air back

ax.land_p.hold._orig: skidding in on the heels: the lead foot dug in far behind, the weight low over the bent knee, the near hand trailing near the floor and the far arm up toward the foe for the balance

ax.land_r.hold._orig: skidding in on the heels like a dropped weight: the lead foot dug in far behind, the weight low over the bent knee, the near fist trailing near the floor and the far fist up toward the foe
